layout_review.visual_metaphor: Four student questions converge into one gold signal; the signal opens a persistent StudyBuddy workspace that turns connected university context into an answer and study tools.
layout_review.screen_media_framing: One large rounded StudyBuddy application surface persists for the full 22-second product journey, with state changes contained inside its main workspace.
layout_review.optical_balance: Asymmetric opening prompts converge centrally; the persistent product shell occupies most of the frame; the final composition resolves to one centered lockup.

scenes.visual_action: Four complete prompts arrive at uneven intervals, remain readable together, and converge only in the final half-second.
scenes.visual_role: The accumulated student questions are the hook; the gold carrier is the reveal anchor.
scenes.personality_device: Asymmetric rounded prompts collect like real interruptions before snapping into one restrained gold signal.

scenes.primary_text: One AI built around your studies
scenes.visual_action: A single persistent StudyBuddy workspace moves continuously from question to connected sources, grounded answer, and three long-held output states.
scenes.visual_role: The application shell is the uninterrupted focal surface; its internal workspace proves each stage without scene cuts.
scenes.personality_device: A recurring gold carrier and continuous LEFT motion connect every internal transformation inside one product window.
scenes.product_focus: StudyBuddy question, Moodle/CIS/Calendar/Mail integration, grounded actions, PDF, interactive guide, quiz, and Moodle Quiz support
scenes.framing_intent: A large persistent rounded desktop workspace occupying approximately four-fifths of the frame

scenes.visual_action: The product carrier completes the StudyBuddy lockup, the claim clears, and the brand remains fully still for 1.8 seconds.
scenes.visual_role: The canonical StudyBuddy lockup is the sole endpoint.
scenes.personality_device: The same gold signal that collected the questions returns once to complete the brand mark, then stops completely.
